maria: Heads-up — change window tonight 00:00-02:00 UTC. Final pin request + launch-readiness check. Rolling traffic 10% -> 50% if smoke OK. No infra config changes during freeze unless emergency.
sasha: Ack. I can own rollback + metrics. Which pin are we using?
kevin: Will run the smoke suite at canary. Allocated 20m after canary spin-up.
maria: Pin: release/edge-2026-03-20-v3.4.1 (sha: a1b2c3d4). Release notes pasted below.
maria: ```
- Fix: reduce kv-cache miss penalty for short prompts
- Perf: serving kernel uplift for Ampere P4s
- Ops: graceful fallback to small-quant model on OOM
```

deploy-bot: /pin applied: release/edge-2026-03-20-v3.4.1 -> prod (initiated by maria) :white_check_mark:
kevin: Canary started @ 10%. Smoke checks: latency p95 < 120ms, error-rate < 0.2%. Uploading logs to S3: s3://redwood-qa/canary/1762349999/
sasha: Good. I reviewed rollback playbook. If we need to roll back: command below and I'll execute.
  ```
  deployctl rollback --to release/edge-2026-03-18-v3.4.0 --scope=prod --force
  ```
ops-bot: Maintenance window recorded: 2026-03-20T00:00:00Z - 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z (change_id: MW-176234)
maria: Freeze rules: no non-rollback code pushes, no config changes to routing, no infra scaling except SRE explicit. If hotfix exemption required, ping @sasha + oncall and tag commit with hotfix-exempt.
kevin: Canary 10% -> 25% after 15m, metrics green. Increasing to 50% in 10m schedule unless objections.
sasha: Go from me for rollout. Rollback owner = sasha, rollback window 00:00-00:30 if anomalies.
maria: Ok locking final go. Release notes updated in the changelog link: https://internal.redwood/release/edge/3.4.1. Sending launch-readiness checklist to #eng-oncall.
kevin: Quick note: if we see KV cache thrash, we roll back traffic and pin to previous release. I'll keep an eye on token throughput dashboards.
deploy-bot: Rollout status: 50% traffic -> release/edge-2026-03-20-v3.4.1. Canary: PASS. Escalation path: #eng-sre -> call SRE oncall.
maria: Thanks team :thumbsup: — will monitor until end of window. If anything odd, @sasha you have the steer to execute rollback.
